# Receiver utilities — G-T7 / G-T2

The authored `cases.json` and independent TypeScript 5.9.3 `reference.json` freeze
70 forms under three strict target/module/library profiles: 210 observations,
105 accepts and 105 rejects. Input and reference hashes are recorded before
production fixes. Ordinary public project tests compare every verdict, complete
primary/related diagnostic with UTF-16 positions, accepted declaration byte and
rejected noEmitOnError artifact inventory.

Every accepted declaration has independently authored positive/negative consumers
that select only the emitted `.d.ts` files, plus a selected-edition syntax check.
Two executable forms across the three profiles provide six runtime comparisons.
The separate six owner/local/runtime checks do not enlarge direct agreement.
Equivalent owner aliases exercise the general conditional/infer implementation;
these utilities acquire no runtime bindings or loader authority.

The [frozen minimum acceptance](../../../../../development/browser_core/phase-18-bluets/RECEIVER_UTILITY_FOLLOWUP.md)
records the finite scope and remaining combinations. Broader feature rows remain
open; name presence and finite observations do not establish full TypeScript parity.
